entities.summary: Wawìra Njirū, is a Kenyan social entrepreneur, nutritionist, and philanthropist, who is the CEO of Food for Education, an organization that serves a hot, nutritious and affordable school meal to over 500,000 public primary school children in the urban and peri-urban areas of Kenya
